speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are experiencing weakness and fatigue; to help me identify the cause, please tell me how long you have been feeling this way and if the symptoms are constant or come and go.

speaker: Patient
text: 33-year-old woman. The patient reports feeling extremely fatigued and weak, especially towards the end of the day, to the point of difficulty in self-care. She mentions experiencing these symptoms currently. The patient has been traveling, hiking, and camping recently and notes having had multiple illnesses in the recent past.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Post-viral myasthenia gravis.

The patient's fatigue worsening at day's end after recent travel and illness is highly suggestive of myasthenia gravis. Could you describe if her weakness affects specific muscles like lifting her eyelids, chewing, or holding her head up?
